info.title: Crumble API
info.description: Shared HTTP contract for Crumble clients. Provider availability and cross-field business rules are validated at runtime.

origin.description: What the bot answered: owner (a message from the owner), task (a scheduled task), bot (another bot's request), group (a group chat turn), or coding or desktop (a job's report; jobName names the job). Clients may receive other values later.

jobName.description: The job whose report the bot answered, for origin coding or desktop. A desktop job's report often asks for the owner; clients may open the bot desktop.

groupId.description: Set when a bot answered in a group chat; open the group rather than the bot chat.

LearnedEvent.description: A bot's review of one of its turns changed its skills or memory, sent as the `learned` event on /v1/events. Clients show a short notice in the bot chat and link to the change record.

coding.description: Whether bots can be given the coding tool on this server.

desktop.description: Whether bots can be given the desktop tool, and with it a bot desktop, on this server.

tools.description: The bot's tools; always includes `schedule` and `codemode`.

sharedMemory.description: True whenever `tools` includes `memory`; the server ignores it in input.

delegates.description: Every other bot; with `delegate` in `tools` this bot may message any of them. The server ignores it in input.

desktopModel.description: The model for this bot's desktop jobs; unset, they use the bot's own model.

review.description: How the bot reviews its turns to learn: whether at all, after how many tool-activity rounds for skills and memory, and how much of a turn a review reads. Unset means enabled with thresholds of 10.

reviewModel.description: The model that runs this bot's reviews; unset, they use the bot's own model.

live.description: Pi Durable live progress state. In-flight assistant message content is omitted.

blocks.description: Provider content blocks, with inline image bytes removed.

toolDetails.description: Provider-specific tool details, including nested code-mode calls.

usage.description: Pi Durable usage document of the job's own conversation: tokens and cost per model and tool. Absent before its first request.
Pi Durable usage document of the job's own conversation: tokens and cost per model and tool. Absent before its first request.

holder.description: Who operates the bot desktop. While the owner holds control, the bot's desktop job pauses and only the owner's viewer input reaches the bot desktop.

changes.description: How often control changed hands. A desktop job refuses actions it planned before a change.

path.description: Server-relative URL of the viewer page, a noVNC client of the bot desktop. Load it in a web view; it works once and expires at expiresAt unless its connection has started by then.

memberIds.description: Member bots in the order they joined.

paused.description: Bot-started turns used up the turn budget; the owner's next message resumes the group.

botTurns.description: Bot-started turns since the owner's last message.

error.description: Why the member's latest turn failed.

name.description: The task, bot, or group chat, as named when the memory was saved.

MemorySource.description: Where the memory was saved: the owner's bot chat, the owner directly, a scheduled task, another bot's request, or a group chat.

thinkingLevels.description: The thinking levels this model takes, from lowest to highest. A bot's level outside them runs at the nearest one.

error.description: Why the server's tools were left out of a bot's last turn, such as a missing sign-in; null once it connects again.

hasOAuthClientSecret.description: Whether the OAuth app's client secret is stored; it is never returned.

oauthClientId.description: The client ID of an OAuth app the owner registered with the server's authorization server, used instead of registering Crumble.

get.description: Server-sent events. Each activity event carries a ReplyEvent or ChatPreviewEvent JSON object in data. Each learned event carries a LearnedEvent: what a bot's review of one turn changed; GET /v1/agents/{id}/reviews lists them durably. Current chat previews replay on connection; finished replies and learned events are not replayed. Heartbeat events carry {} every 15 seconds. Authenticate with the Authorization header. No Last-Event-ID replay.
